pages.text: The Wayroot is a graft kept under a copper arm. Pale bark holds it in shape. Fungal tissue feels for distant traces, and amber carries the Resonance between them. The copper guides where that current can go.
pages.title: The threshold
An address
pages.text: Choose a charter and read its requirements before sealing it. The graft can find an address and a way home. It cannot promise safe footing.

pages.title: Before entry
pages.text: The portal opens above the terminal. Take food, a weapon and room for cargo. Entering issues the route compass.

pages.title: Before entry
pages.text: Guests can join an open party until the first checkpoint. Set Party access to Solo Expedition to keep the portal private. First Bearing is always private and teaches two marks and a return.
Place it facing a safe space. Its portal opens above it.
